text: Which AWS Support plan is the least expensive one that includes a designated Technical Account Manager?
explanation_en: Enterprise On-Ramp includes a pool of Technical Account Managers, while Enterprise provides a designated TAM. Business and Developer include no TAM at all.
tip: TAM ladder: Basic and Developer = none. Business = none (but 24/7 tech support). Enterprise On-Ramp = pool of TAMs. Enterprise = a designated TAM. If the stem says TAM, only the two Enterprise tiers qualify.

text: Which two AWS Support plans provide 24/7 access to technical support engineers by phone, chat, and email? (Choose two.)
explanation_en: Business and Enterprise (and Enterprise On-Ramp) provide 24/7 technical support through phone, chat, and email. Developer offers business-hours email access only, and Basic has no technical support.
tip: BASIC = no technical support at all. DEVELOPER = email, business hours, one contact. BUSINESS and above = 24/7 phone, chat and email, unlimited contacts. The words 'phone' or '24/7' eliminate Basic and Developer.

text: How much does the AWS Developer Support plan cost at minimum?
explanation_en: Developer support starts at $29 per month or 3 percent of monthly AWS usage, whichever is greater.
tip: Price floors to memorize: Basic FREE, Developer $29 (or 3%), Business $100 (tiered %), Enterprise On-Ramp $5,500 (or 10%), Enterprise $15,000 (tiered %). The exam asks these as bare numbers.

text: A team wants a single console view that flags underutilized instances, missing MFA on the root user, and how close the account is to its service quotas. Which Trusted Advisor categories cover these three findings?
explanation_en: Underutilized instances fall under cost optimization, root MFA under security, and quota headroom under service limits. Trusted Advisor exposes exactly five categories: cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance and service limits. Replication, compliance and availability are not among them.
tip: Five categories only: COST OPTIMIZATION, PERFORMANCE, SECURITY, FAULT TOLERANCE, SERVICE LIMITS. 'Replication', 'Availability' and 'Compliance' are the invented ones.

text: Which two Trusted Advisor checks are available to accounts on the Basic support plan? (Choose two.)
explanation_en: Basic and Developer plans include seven core checks, among them MFA on Root Account and Service Limits. The full set of cost and performance checks requires Business or Enterprise support.
tip: Basic/Developer get only 7 free core checks, and the two most quoted are MFA ON ROOT and SERVICE LIMITS. Anything that saves money by finding idle resources requires BUSINESS support or higher.

text: Which tool lets you visualize and analyze your AWS costs and usage over the past 12 months and forecast the next 12?
explanation_en: Cost Explorer visualizes historical cost and usage data and produces forecasts. Budgets sets alerts, and the Pricing Calculator estimates costs before you deploy.
tip: Timeline test: PRICING CALCULATOR = BEFORE you deploy (estimate). COST EXPLORER = AFTER (analyze history, forecast 12 months, data refreshed every 24 h). BUDGETS = alert me when I approach a threshold. CUR = the most detailed raw export.

text: A finance team wants an email alert when monthly spend is forecast to exceed $5,000. Which service should they use?
explanation_en: AWS Budgets sends alerts when actual or forecasted cost, usage, or reservation coverage crosses a threshold you define.
tip: The word ALERT, NOTIFY or THRESHOLD in a cost question always means AWS BUDGETS. Cost Explorer only shows you data - it does not notify anyone.

text: What is the main billing benefit of consolidated billing in AWS Organizations?

options.A: Volume pricing discounts are applied across the combined usage of all accounts
options.B: Each account receives an independent free tier every month
options.C: All accounts share a single set of IAM users
options.D: Support plans are automatically upgraded to Enterprise

explanation_en: Consolidated billing aggregates usage across accounts so tiered volume discounts and reservation benefits apply to the combined total, with one bill for the organization.
tip: Consolidated billing = ONE BILL + AGGREGATED VOLUME DISCOUNTS + shared Reserved Instance and Savings Plan benefits. It does NOT merge IAM, and the free tier is shared, not multiplied.

text: Which tool estimates the monthly cost of an architecture before any resources are created?
explanation_en: The AWS Pricing Calculator models a planned architecture and produces a cost estimate before deployment.
tip: 'BEFORE deploying', 'estimate', 'planning' = PRICING CALCULATOR. Everything else in the billing family looks at money you have already spent.

text: Which two AWS services are free to use, with charges applying only to the resources they create or manage? (Choose two.)
explanation_en: CloudFormation and Elastic Beanstalk carry no service charge; you pay only for the underlying resources they provision. RDS and Redshift bill for the instances themselves.
tip: Free AWS services worth remembering: IAM, VPC, CloudFormation, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, Organizations, License Manager, and the Pricing Calculator. You still pay for what they create.

text: Which pricing model charges nothing when a Lambda function is not being invoked?
explanation_en: Lambda uses pay-as-you-go pricing based on the number of requests and the compute duration, so an idle function costs nothing.
tip: Serverless = you pay per REQUEST and per DURATION, and idle costs zero. Contrast with EC2 (pay while running) and Lightsail (flat monthly rate regardless of use).

text: Which two statements about AWS data transfer pricing are correct? (Choose two.)

options.A: Data transferred into AWS from the internet is generally free
options.B: Data transferred out of AWS to the internet is generally charged
options.C: All data transfer within a region is always free
options.D: Data transfer out is free up to 10 TB per month for every account

explanation_en: Inbound data transfer from the internet is generally free while outbound transfer is billed. Transfer between availability zones inside a region is charged, so not all in-region traffic is free.
tip: Rule of thumb: DATA IN IS FREE, DATA OUT COSTS. Cross-AZ traffic inside a region is also billed. That single asymmetry explains most surprise bills on the exam.

text: Which support plan is required to get architectural guidance in the context of your specific use case, rather than general best practices?
explanation_en: Business support provides contextual guidance based on your use case, while Developer offers only general architectural guidance and Enterprise adds a consultative review.
tip: Guidance ladder: DEVELOPER = general guidance. BUSINESS = contextual to YOUR use case. ENTERPRISE = consultative review and a designated TAM. Match the adjective in the stem to the tier.

text: Finance asks the platform team to report monthly spend split by product line without creating separate accounts. Which capability makes that possible?

options.A: Cost allocation tags activated in the billing console
options.B: An IAM policy that limits who can launch resources
options.C: A billing alarm set per product line
options.D: Separate VPCs for each product line

explanation_en: Cost allocation tags let you group and report costs by any dimension you tag, such as project or cost center. They must be activated in the billing console before they appear in reports.
tip: Tags are the ONLY way to attribute cost to a team, project or environment. Note they must be ACTIVATED in the billing console first, and they never enforce permissions - that is IAM's job.

text: Which two are true about the AWS Free Tier? (Choose two.)

options.A: Some offers expire 12 months after account creation
options.B: Some offers are always free with no expiration
options.C: All AWS services have a free tier
options.D: The free tier removes all charges for the first year

explanation_en: The free tier has three types of offer: 12-month introductory offers, always-free offers such as the Lambda monthly request allowance, and short-term trials. It does not cover every service or every charge.
tip: Three free-tier flavors: 12 MONTHS (EC2 t2.micro hours, S3 5 GB), ALWAYS FREE (Lambda 1M requests, DynamoDB 25 GB), TRIALS (short-term). Never assume everything is free for a year.

text: Which report provides the most granular, line-item detail of AWS usage and cost?
explanation_en: The Cost and Usage Report delivers the most detailed data available, at hourly or daily granularity per line item, and can be delivered to S3.
tip: When the stem says MOST GRANULAR, MOST DETAILED or LINE ITEM, the answer is the COST AND USAGE REPORT delivered to S3 - not Cost Explorer, which is the visual summary.

text: Which two payment options are available when purchasing a Reserved Instance? (Choose two.)
explanation_en: Reserved Instances can be purchased as All Upfront, Partial Upfront, or No Upfront, over a one or three year term. More upfront payment means a larger discount.
tip: Three payment options only: ALL UPFRONT (biggest discount), PARTIAL UPFRONT, NO UPFRONT. Terms are 1 or 3 years. 'Monthly Upfront' and 'Deferred' do not exist.

text: An organization wants to prevent a member account from being able to use an expensive service at all. Which feature enforces this?
explanation_en: A service control policy in AWS Organizations denies access to the service outright. Budgets and alarms only notify after spending occurs.
tip: Budgets and alarms only TELL YOU. Only an SCP can PREVENT the spend from happening. If the stem uses 'prevent', 'block' or 'enforce', it is not a billing tool - it is an SCP.

text: Which AWS program provides third-party software that can be purchased and billed through your AWS account?
explanation_en: AWS Marketplace is the digital catalog of third-party software with purchases billed through your AWS account. Service Catalog manages approved internal products.
tip: MARKETPLACE = buy third-party software, billed on your AWS invoice, verified AMIs. SERVICE CATALOG = a curated internal list your own organization approves. Do not swap them.

text: Which two factors determine the cost of an Amazon S3 bucket? (Choose two.)

options.D: The length of the bucket name

explanation_en: S3 charges are based on storage volume, storage class, number and type of requests, and data transfer out. Creating a bucket itself costs nothing.
tip: S3 billing dimensions: STORAGE (GB by class), REQUESTS, DATA TRANSFER OUT, plus management features. Creating an empty bucket is free - which is why deleting empty buckets saves nothing.
